settings.jenaLoaderJava: Jena6.2 package wrapper selects its pinned Java21; JAVA and JAVA_HOME removed only for the loader

floatOracle.method: each engine served the same data alone with the binaries of this record, its raw SPARQL JSON answers were kept, and q4 and q5 were compared with exact means of the float-rounded prices within the error bound of a float summation in any order

answerOracle.method: Independent streaming N-Triples arithmetic and set membership; fingerprint code binds the verdict to the retained response and does not compute expected answers.

captures.note: Retained correctness captures are separate requests from timing samples. The 80-row pooled Fluree q7 capture replaces an unavailable earlier 77-row fingerprint; the earlier body was not checked.
